name: TensorPM v1.44.0
body:
# Changelog - v1.44.0

This update rebuilds the browser agent: you now watch it work on the real page, it runs on the
same AI as your chat, and it tells you clearly what happened. On top of that, every dropdown now
uses the TensorPM design, and the budget tab fits next to an open AI panel.

## 🌐 Browser agent: visible, reliable, understandable

- **Watch the real page:** the browser dock shows the live page the agent is working on, no
  longer a preview image that could freeze, shrink or stop updating after a website switch (for
  example when Google showed a captcha page).
- **Your input stays out of the way:** while the agent drives, clicks and keys in the dock don't
  reach the page. Choose _Take control_ to use the page yourself and _Return to agent_ to hand it
  back.
- **The page keeps its layout:** websites are shown at a desktop width at any dock size, also
  after the agent moves to another website.
- **Every run shows itself:** the dock opens on the agent's tab when a run starts, also from the
  side panel or from an empty chat. Before, a run started from an empty chat could end up hidden,
  together with its answer.
- **Runs on your chat's AI:** the browser agent now uses the same AI as the chat. With TensorPM AI
  that is the regular TensorPM AI model, with no separate model and no stored key picked at
  random. Your own API keys are used on plans that include them (Business).
- **Clear reasons when something stops:** if you are signed out, your AI credits are used up or
  TensorPM AI can't be reached, the dock and the chat say so in plain words. Where you can fix
  it, a _Sign in_ or _Show details_ button takes you there. The run stops right away instead of
  retrying for minutes.
- **Stop means stop:** _Stop_ ends the run immediately, also while the agent is waiting for the
  AI, and no further action runs afterwards.
- **Your language:** step goals and the final answer come in the app language. In German, the
  agent addresses you with "du", like the rest of the app.
- **Approvals you can read:** an action waiting for your approval reads like
  _Click "Buy"_ or _Type "toilet seat" into "Search"_. Actions that only read a page (scrolling,
  searching on the page, reading content) no longer ask for approval.
- **A clear ending:** after a run, the dock shows the outcome, the tokens used and the run time.
  The result itself is in the chat.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Sync conflict you couldn't resolve:** since 1.38.1, the result message of a browser run
  could not be synced. It showed up as a conflict where neither version could be accepted. The
  update repairs these messages automatically; they then sync normally and the conflict
  disappears.
- **Finished tasks reported as "blocked":** a captcha page the agent met on the way no longer
  marks a task as blocked when the agent found another way and finished it.
- **No more wait after each run:** a browser run used to linger for about 8 seconds after its
  result before it was closed.
- **Names from the AI with "&":** budget positions, cost entries, categories and material
  that the AI creates or renames now show "&" instead of "&amp;".

## 🎨 Improvements

- **Every dropdown in the TensorPM design:** the remaining dropdowns that opened in the style of
  your operating system (budget inbox, cost entry dialog, currency field, bug report, file
  upload, browser dock, repository switcher, people, workspace management, quick task creation,
  onboarding) now look and behave like the rest of the app, including keyboard use.
- **Budget tab fits its space:** the cost position table adapts to the available width. With the
  AI panel open, bars are hidden first, then rows stack, so nothing runs out of view. Inbox rows
  line up with the table, and amounts no longer break across lines.

## 📝 Notes

- **Credits on Trial and Pro:** browser runs now use TensorPM AI on these plans, like the chat,
  and count toward your AI credits. Before, the browser agent could use an API key you had stored
  for another provider.
- Existing names that already contain "&amp;" are not changed automatically. Rename them once
  by hand.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.44.0
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-18
- **Previous Version**: 1.43.0
- **Type**: Minor Release
